map.品牌价值评估（收益倍率口径）：品牌利润 = 年营收 × 利润率%；份额系数 =: Brand value assessment (income-multiple basis): brand profit = annual revenue × profit margin %; share factor = min(share % ÷ 10, 5); brand value = brand profit × industry multiplier × duration factor × share factor (10,000 CNY), with the 100-million-CNY scale divided by 10000. Validation: revenue, profit margin, multiplier and duration must be >0, and profit margin and share must be ≤100; otherwise report an error for each and return. Criterion: ≥100000 (10,000 CNY) top brand (≥1 billion CNY), ≥10000 well-known (100 million–1 billion CNY), ≥1000 regional (10–100 million CNY), otherwise startup brand.
